body:
Changes
- Added in-memory data reader `InMemoryColumnData`
- Added new supertype `AbstractColumnData` to group `InMemoryColumnData` and `ColumnDataset`
- Added `GCMColumnData.read` which reads the grouped cfsite netCDF, time-averages it into steady profiles, and returns an `InMemoryColumnData`
- Added `era5_dataset` to consolidate `ReanalysisTimeVarying` and `ReanalysisMonthlyAveragedDiurnal` cases
- Removed the `GCMDriven` Setup. To use this case, set `initial_condition: GCM` as well as `cfsite_number` and `external_forcing_file`
- Trimmed redundant `external_forcing` options to just `nothing` and `ReanalysisMonthlyAveragedDiurnal`
title: Port GCMDriven SCM case to the generic column forcing interface
